description: Named the threepence, and cut what she was given.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Was not in the room. The sheet is addressed to her.
name: Anne Shakespeare

description: Asked with the jug in her other hand, priced the loaf, and sent the seamstress rather than the man who tore the sleeve.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Was not in the room. The hands in the letter are hers.
name: Edith Kettlewood

description: Took the shut act as a clean board, and did not ask for the third.
name: Gillis Verbeke

description: Kept the text plain, and asked only that the pew be left as it was found.
name: Master Josias Thwaite

description: Was not in the room. The sleeve in the letter is his.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Set the pen down under the barn line.
name: William Shakespeare
